text:
maria (support-advocate): Customer reports 404s and a retry storm after upgrading their app dependency to @redwood/sdk@0.23. They say chat.create started returning "route not found" and the client keeps retrying. Repro steps below.

sophie (support): Can you drop the exact error and their package.json / snippet?

maria (support-advocate): Error they pasted: 
```
Error: 404 Not Found: /v1/chat.create
    at Request.handleResponse (/app/node_modules/@redwood/sdk/lib/request.js:142:21)
    at processTicksAndRejections (internal/process/task_queues.js:93:5)
```
Their package.json deps: `"@redwood/sdk": "^0.23.0", "node": "16.x"`
Repro snippet they used:
```js
const Redwood = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: 'gpt-3b', messages: [{role: 'user', content: 'hi'}] });
```
They say same code worked on 0.21.

sophie (support): Thanks. Sounds like an SDK/API contract mismatch. Adding @jordan from SDK team. @jordan can you weigh in? :eyes: 

jordan (sdk): Looking now. Quick hypothesis: our v0.23 release introduced a param rename in the client shim (messages -> input) but the hosted API still expects `messages` for /v1/chat.create. If the client is sending `input` it might call an internal compatibility route that doesn't exist, hence 404.

maria (support-advocate): I asked the customer to paste a raw request from their app (curl). They returned this outgoing JSON payload: `{"model":"gpt-3b","input":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}`

jordan (sdk): Yep—confirmed. SDK v0.23 serializes `input` at the top level. We mistakenly changed the field to align with a planned API change that hasn't been rolled out to hosted endpoints yet. That explains the 404 and retry loop.

ashok (eng): We need a short-term mitigation for the customer (can't block them). Options: 1) Ask them to pin to @redwood/sdk@0.22.x (rollback) — fastest. 2) Server-side compatibility shim for hosted API to accept `input` and map to `messages` (we can hotfix). 3) Patch the SDK and release 0.23.1 with the old behavior.

sophie (support): Customer prefers not to downgrade if avoidable. Can we hotfix the API for compatibility?

ashok (eng): I'll open an emergency PR to add a tiny compatibility layer that accepts `input` arrays for chat endpoints and maps to `messages`. Will route through QA. ETA ~2–3 hours for canary.

jordan (sdk): I'll prepare a 0.23.1 that reverts the serialization so clients aren't blocked if the hotfix takes longer. Will also add a feature-flag and clear changelog entry.

maria (support-advocate): Thanks — told customer we'll either patch on server side or push 0.23.1 and share steps. Also gave them a short-term workaround: change call to `client._rawRequest('POST','/v1/chat.create', { model: 'gpt-3b', messages: [...] })` or run `npm install @redwood/sdk@0.22.4` until fix.

jordan (sdk): For transparency — creating GH issue and will add a note in release notes and changelog. Also adding telemetry: SDK will send header `x-rw-sdk` with version so server can detect mismatch and emit a better 4xx with recommended action instead of generic 404.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline triggered: hotfix-api-compatibility -> canary (env: hosted-us). Logs: queued. :truck: 

ashok (eng): Canary passed basic smoke. Patching now to prod. Rolling in 30m with an automatic fallback that logs any `input` usages.

maria (support-advocate): Customer confirmed they can wait for hotfix, will test after patch. Please post update when live so I can close the ticket. :pray:

jordan (sdk): 0.23.1 draft published — reverts param rename and adds compatibility flag. Recommend we push a small notice to the SDK changelog and docs.

ashok (eng): Prod rollout complete. Hotfix mapped `input` -> `messages` for `/v1/chat.create` and `/v1/chat.stream`. We also now emit `x-rw-compat: mismatched-sdk` when we detect the old/new mismatch so support can escalate faster.

maria (support-advocate): Confirmed with customer: calls succeed, retries stopped. They opted to stay on 0.23.1 but will watch for churn. Closing after a follow-up in 24h. :thumbsup:

sophie (support): Great work. Action items: - @jordan follow up with permanent SDK test against hosted API matrix - @ashok ensure telemetry logs are searchable for `x-rw-compat` - @maria confirm customer stability in 24h

jordan (sdk): On it. Will add integration test into CI that runs basic chat endpoints against canary/prod matrix on each SDK release.

maria (support-advocate): Will ping in 24h with status, closing thread for now. Thanks team.
